title: Variant Management
description: OpenUI5-compatible view selection, Save View and Manage Views with application-owned persistence.

usage.summary: Save, select and maintain named views of filter or table personalization settings.
useWhen: Let users return to recurring combinations of filter values or table settings through saved views.
Let users organize views through naming, favorites, defaults and sharing when the application supports them.
Handle onSelect, onSave and onManage in the host application; this control does not persist or retrieve view settings itself.

avoidWhen.when: Choose one of 2–12 fixed predefined views without creating or managing saved settings; sort alphabetically above 8.
Edit current filter criteria without saving or managing reusable views.
Adjust sorting, grouping or predefined filter values for the current view without saving it.
